title: SQLite analytical notebook
description: Fresh in-memory analytical database: import 4,192 generated rows, create three indexes, and execute eight frozen join, group-by, window and ordered-result queries.

inputs.generation: xorshift32 seed 0x0051a17e; 64 customers, 32 products, 4,096 sales; CC0-1.0

oracle.policy: Every ordered cell from all eight result sets must equal the independent sqlite3 reference; frozen canonical SHA-256 fae41d80865456365118c98ee8dd74a502fb359ace69878190edca22e4f6572d.
oracle.floatingPointPolicy: All fixture values and computed outputs are safe integers. Non-integer and non-finite output is rejected.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: All 744 result rows are canonicalized, compared cell-for-cell, and hashed.

work.complexity: Product-specific SQL planning over identical schema, data, indexes and query text
work.tolerance: All logical work counters are exact. Product plans remain separately labelled because the frozen equivalence class is semantic-product-choice.
